title: strings escape the tambora
story: Nunca Es Suficiente is a 95 bpm cumbia sonidera; the break (6754-6994) drops the drums to a thin pattern and the strings and synth carry the melody. The picture stays the steady string family of escape: each bar tambora downbeat lifts the strings grosor and brightness, the spread steps every two beats, and the lines sway and tension change only at the phrase boundaries, one step each. The four strong hits at 6890-6971 each flash the strings, burst the pluck swing and shake, then the drums return at 6995 and the groove settles into the same state as the start.
